title: Same room can be sold twice for overlapping dates (no double-booking prevention)
whatHappensNow: Two concurrent POST /bookings requests for the same room and dates both succeed, creating two active reservations for one room.
fixNeeded: PostgreSQL exclusion constraint on (roomId, daterange) + Serializable transaction in availability check. HTTP 409 on second request.

title: Duplicate room numbers allowed within same property
whatHappensNow: Creating two rooms with the same number in one property succeeds silently.
fixNeeded: @@unique([propertyId, number]) constraint on Room model. API returns 409 on duplicate.

title: GST computed but CGST/SGST/IGST not stored per line; discount applied after tax instead of before
whatHappensNow: Invoice shows a single tax amount. No CGST/SGST breakdown on folio lines. Discount reduces tax base incorrectly.
fixNeeded: Add CGST, SGST, IGST, taxable, sacCode columns to FolioTransaction and InvoiceItem. Compute GST after discount on taxable base.

title: GST slab not applied correctly at booking creation for different tariff bands
whatHappensNow: New booking for ₹8,000/night room shows 5% GST instead of 18%. Tariff threshold logic not wired to booking creation.
fixNeeded: Call computeRoomGst() at booking creation; store rate on FolioTransaction.

title: Folio charges do not carry CGST/SGST/IGST breakdown
whatHappensNow: FolioTransaction has a single taxAmount field. CGST/SGST/IGST split is computed at display time (and incorrectly) rather than stored.
fixNeeded: Add cgst, sgst, igst, taxable, sacCode to FolioTransaction. Store on write.

title: Payments do not create journal entries — Cash Book is empty
whatHappensNow: Recording a folio payment updates the folio balance but writes no JournalEntry. Cash Book shows no entries.
fixNeeded: Create JournalEntry + JournalLine (balanced debit/credit) on every payment, charge, refund, discount, void in a transaction.

title: Day Book and Ledger show no data — ledger tables not populated
whatHappensNow: accounts/day-book and accounts/ledger pages query JournalEntry which does not exist in schema; pages show empty.
fixNeeded: Implement JournalEntry / JournalLine model and populate from all money-moving actions.

title: GST report shows figures that do not match issued invoices
whatHappensNow: GST summary on reports page is computed ad-hoc from FolioTransaction amounts, not from issued Invoice records. Figures mismatch actual invoices.
fixNeeded: GST report and GSTR-1 export must read only from Invoice records with status=ISSUED.

title: Night audit is not idempotent — running twice posts double room charges
whatHappensNow: POST /api/hotel/night-audit with RUN_ALL action checks if a charge was posted 'today' using a string match on description, not an idempotency key. Timing or description variation causes duplicate postings.
fixNeeded: NightAuditRun table with (propertyId, auditDate) unique key. Each step writes NightAuditStep. Room charge posts only if no ROOM_RENT FolioTransaction exists for that room and that business date.

title: Room portal QR token does not expire at checkout — ex-guest can still access the portal
whatHappensNow: RoomPortalSession token has no expiry tied to checkout. After checkout the portal still shows the ex-guest's data.
fixNeeded: On checkout: set RoomPortalSession.isActive=false and logoutAt=now(). Portal middleware returns 403 if isActive=false.

title: Receptionist can access payroll, backup, settings and revenue APIs — no RBAC enforcement
whatHappensNow: No middleware.ts; API routes check role by name ad-hoc. A receptionist can call GET /api/hotel/payroll or /api/hotel/backup and get data.
fixNeeded: requirePermission(session, permission) in every protected route. middleware.ts blocks route access by role. Receptionist cannot access payroll, backup, revenue, settings, users, AI keys.

title: Role permissions from DB not loaded into session — permission array always empty
whatHappensNow: Session.permissions is optional and never populated from RolePermission table. All permission checks fall back to role-name string comparison.
fixNeeded: On login, query RolePermission JOIN Permission for the user's role; embed permissions[] in JWT.

title: Analytics dashboard shows hardcoded/demo metrics not from real data
whatHappensNow: Analytics page shows static occupancy percentage and revenue figures that do not change with real bookings.
fixNeeded: All analytics KPIs (Occupancy %, ADR, RevPAR, Revenue) must come from real DB queries. Show empty state when no data.

title: Booking engine preview link points to localhost:3000
whatHappensNow: hotel/booking-engine/page.tsx has href='http://localhost:3000/book'. Clicking it in production opens localhost.
fixNeeded: Replace with NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL/book/[propertySlug].

title: Counter Payments total includes room-posted orders — inflated cash figure
whatHappensNow: Counter Payments page sums all PAID orders including those posted to room folios. Cash/UPI figures are overstated.
fixNeeded: Filter: exclude PosOrders where folioId IS NOT NULL (room-posted) from counter payment totals.

title: Backup copies SQLite to Desktop — not a real server backup; fails in cloud hosting
whatHappensNow: npm run backup:start writes to ~/Desktop and local backups/ directory. Vercel hosting has no persistent disk; backups are lost on each deploy.
fixNeeded: Server-side pg_dump (or SQLite dump) → compress → encrypt → upload to S3/R2/GCS. Record BackupRun in DB.

title: Room can be created with negative or zero base rate
whatHappensNow: POST /api/hotel/room-types accepts baseRate: 0 or baseRate: -500 without error.
fixNeeded: Zod validator: baseRate must be a positive integer (paise). API returns 400 on invalid.

title: Room category code is not unique per property — duplicate codes cause data confusion
whatHappensNow: Two RoomTypes can have the same code within the same property.
fixNeeded: @@unique([propertyId, code]) on RoomType model.

title: Over-limit discount applied instantly without admin approval
whatHappensNow: A receptionist can apply a 50% discount even when property.maxStaffDiscountPercent = 10. No approval gate exists in the API.
fixNeeded: Discount service checks limit; if exceeded, creates ApprovalRequest(PENDING) and returns 202 instead of applying immediately.

title: Invoice can be re-issued / mutated after ISSUED status — breaking audit trail
whatHappensNow: No immutability check on Invoice status. PATCH /invoices can change amounts on an issued invoice.
fixNeeded: Any write to an Invoice with status=ISSUED is rejected with 409. Changes require a CreditNote.

title: Customer display (order-display) shows guest names and room numbers for room service orders
whatHappensNow: Kitchen/bar display shows full guest name and room number for room service KOTs. Privacy violation — kitchen staff should only see the KOT number and items.
fixNeeded: For ROOM_SERVICE order type: show only KOT number and items, no guest name or room number on the public-facing display.

title: Over-limit discount request never reaches admin queue — admin sees nothing
whatHappensNow: Even if approval logic were triggered, there is no ApprovalRequest table, no admin notification, and no approval inbox in the UI.
fixNeeded: Create ApprovalRequest model. Notify admin via in-app Notification + WhatsApp. Admin can approve/reject from /hotel/discounts page.

title: Hotel dashboard KPIs (revenue, occupancy, ADR) not from real data
whatHappensNow: Dashboard metrics are either hardcoded or pulled from incomplete queries that don't reflect actual bookings and payments.
fixNeeded: Single metrics.service.ts computes Occupancy%, ADR, RevPAR, Total Revenue from canonical sources. All dashboard widgets use it.

title: No backup status or alert in admin panel — owner does not know if backup is stale
whatHappensNow: No BackupRun record exists. Admin backup page shows only a manual trigger button.
fixNeeded: BackupRun table. Admin panel shows last successful backup time. Alert if > 26 hours since last success.

title: Business date computed in UTC, not IST — midnight-to-6am bookings go to wrong day
whatHappensNow: Most routes use new Date() + setHours(0,0,0,0) which is UTC midnight (5:30am IST). Night audit posts charges to wrong date for stays arriving or departing at night.
fixNeeded: Create lib/time.ts with businessDate(tz) using Intl.DateTimeFormat. All date computations use this. Property.timezone field added.

title: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL is localhost:3000 in .env — QR codes and booking links broken in production
whatHappensNow: .env has NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3000. All generated URLs (QR, booking engine, guest portal) use this in production.
fixNeeded: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://ordermintpms.tech in production. Use this everywhere instead of hardcoded localhost.

title: Folio closing balance can go negative without warning
whatHappensNow: Payment greater than the folio balance is accepted silently, resulting in a negative closing balance shown as a 'credit'.
fixNeeded: Validate payment amount <= folio.closingBalance + advance. Return 400 if overpayment detected without intent (refund path).

title: Receptionist can trigger backup download — unauthorized access to full DB
whatHappensNow: Backup page and backup API have no role check. Any logged-in user can trigger a DB backup.
fixNeeded: requirePermission(session, 'backup.run') on backup API. Only OWNER and SUPER_ADMIN roles have this permission.

title: Revenue dashboard only shows one source (room) — POS, spa, banquet not included
whatHappensNow: Revenue API sums FolioTransactions for ROOM_RENT only. POS revenue, spa charges and banquet are excluded.
fixNeeded: metrics.service.ts aggregates all revenue sources: room rent + POS settled + spa + banquet + extras.

title: Daily report page shows static placeholder data
whatHappensNow: hotel/night-audit/daily-report shows values that do not update with real hotel activity.
fixNeeded: daily-report API reads from DayClosing or computes from canonical sources for the requested business date.

title: Channel manager shows 'connected' status but is not actually syncing with any OTA
whatHappensNow: ChannelConnection records exist in DB but channel-manager/sync endpoint returns fake success without calling any CM API.
fixNeeded: Show real connection status (never connected by default). Hide 'Simulate OTA Sync' button outside dev.

title: Smart Hotel dashboard shows fake device states
whatHappensNow: smart-hotel page shows device toggle UIs with mock on/off states. No TTLock or real IoT integration.
fixNeeded: Show empty state / 'Not configured' until TTLock API is integrated. Remove fake device data.

title: Banquet page shows hardcoded event list with 'Sharma Wedding Reception' placeholder
whatHappensNow: Banquet page has a hardcoded event list in the UI state. API for banquet bookings does not exist.
fixNeeded: Implement BanquetBooking model and API. Banquet page reads from DB. Empty state when no events.

title: Day closing opening cash can be set to any value including negative
whatHappensNow: Opening cash field accepts negative values. No validation.
fixNeeded: Zod validator: openingCash >= 0. Early check-in/out time validation added.

title: POS 'Post to Room' picker does not check room availability / active check-in
whatHappensNow: Room selection in room-charge flow does not validate that the selected room has an active check-in. Charges can be posted to vacant rooms.
fixNeeded: POST /api/hotel/post-to-room validates roomId has an ACTIVE CheckIn. Returns 400 if room is not occupied.

title: Multiple open folios can exist for one reservation — balance confusion
whatHappensNow: No uniqueness check on Folio(reservationId, status=OPEN). Multiple concurrent requests can create two OPEN folios for one reservation.
fixNeeded: @@unique([reservationId]) or upsert pattern on folio open. At most one OPEN folio per reservation.

title: Advance payment on booking does not post to ledger
whatHappensNow: Reservation.advanceAmount is updated but no FolioTransaction credit or JournalEntry is created.
fixNeeded: On advance payment: create FolioTransaction (CREDIT) + JournalEntry (balanced) in one DB transaction.

title: Agent KYC fields accept unvalidated data — invalid GST/PAN can be saved
whatHappensNow: Agent creation accepts any string in gstNumber and pan fields without format validation.
fixNeeded: Zod validators for GSTIN (15-char + checksum) and PAN (10-char alphanumeric format).

title: AI Concierge API key (Gemini) accessible to receptionist role
whatHappensNow: AI concierge settings page shows and allows editing of Gemini API key. No role check on the settings page or API.
fixNeeded: requirePermission(session, 'settings.ai') on AI settings API. Only OWNER can read/write AI keys.

title: Indian mobile number not validated — 7-digit or non-Indian numbers accepted
whatHappensNow: Guest mobile field accepts any string. 7-digit numbers, letters, and non-Indian formats are saved.
fixNeeded: Zod: mobile.regex(/^[6-9]\d{9}$/) for Indian mobile. Aadhaar: 12 digits + Verhoeff checksum.

title: Checkout does not check for outstanding folio balance before allowing checkout
whatHappensNow: Guest can be checked out even when folio closingBalance > 0. No settlement required.
fixNeeded: Checkout API validates folio.closingBalance == 0 (or advance covers it). Returns 400 with balance amount if unsettled.

title: Loyalty points can be manually adjusted by any user without approval
whatHappensNow: Any staff with access to loyalty page can add or deduct points without audit or approval.
fixNeeded: Points adjustment above threshold requires ApprovalRequest. All adjustments logged in LoyaltyLog with userId.

title: Complimentary order (100% discount) does not require manager approval
whatHappensNow: POS allows marking an order as complimentary (0 charge) without any approval or PIN.
fixNeeded: Complimentary order creates ApprovalRequest or requires manager PIN verification.

title: Room service GST not computed as F&B GST — wrong SAC code on folio
whatHappensNow: Room service charges posted to folio use room SAC code (996311) instead of F&B SAC code (996331).
fixNeeded: Room service and restaurant charges use computeFoodGst() with SAC 996331.

title: HSN/SAC code summary in reports is incorrect — wrong codes per line type
whatHappensNow: GST report groups all charges under a single SAC code. F&B and room charges should use different codes.
fixNeeded: Every FolioTransaction and InvoiceItem stores sacCode. Report groups by sacCode.

title: Spa admin page accessible to all hotel roles — no permission check
whatHappensNow: hotel/spa page has no role check. Kitchen staff can access spa booking and pricing settings.
fixNeeded: requirePermission(session, 'spa.view') on spa API. Only OWNER, GM, FRONT_DESK roles.

title: Room discount percentage accepts values over 100 and negative values
whatHappensNow: Room.discount field accepts -10 or 150. No validation.
fixNeeded: Zod: discount between 0 and 100 inclusive.

title: Expense records do not post to accounting voucher/ledger
whatHappensNow: Creating an Expense record does not create a Voucher or JournalEntry. The Day Book does not show expenses.
fixNeeded: Expense creation posts a JournalEntry (Dr: Expense account, Cr: Cash/Bank account).

title: Night audit does not roll the business date — same date shown next morning
whatHappensNow: After night audit completes, Property.businessDate is not incremented. Night audit can be run multiple times on same date.
fixNeeded: NightAuditRun records (propertyId, auditDate) unique. Last step increments Property.businessDate +1 day.

title: Manager PIN for instant discount approval is 4 digits and stored in plaintext
whatHappensNow: Property.managerDiscountPin default is '1234' stored as plain text. 4 digits is too short.
fixNeeded: Minimum 6 digits; hash with argon2 before storing. Lockout after 5 consecutive failures.

title: 'Simulate OTA Sync' and 'Test Email Booking' buttons visible in production
whatHappensNow: These debug buttons appear in the production UI for all users.
fixNeeded: Show only when NODE_ENV=development or APP_ENV=staging.

title: Dashboard clock shows UTC time, not IST
whatHappensNow: Live clock on hotel dashboard ticks in UTC.
fixNeeded: Use Intl.DateTimeFormat with Asia/Kolkata to display IST.

title: Room status board does not refresh automatically
whatHappensNow: Room board requires manual page refresh to see status changes.
fixNeeded: Poll /api/hotel/rooms/board every 60s or use socket.io push.

title: Room category (RoomType) has no Edit button — categories cannot be modified
whatHappensNow: Room types can be created but not edited after creation.
fixNeeded: Add Edit button on RoomType list. PATCH /api/hotel/room-types/[id] endpoint.

title: Booking form does not show real-time availability — blocked rooms still selectable
whatHappensNow: Room dropdown in booking form lists all rooms regardless of existing reservations for the selected dates.
fixNeeded: Availability API filters out rooms with overlapping RESERVED or CHECKED_IN bookings.

title: Folio number sequence not guaranteed unique under concurrent creation
whatHappensNow: Folio number is generated from count+1 without locking. Concurrent check-ins can produce duplicate folio numbers.
fixNeeded: Use DB sequence or upsert pattern with unique constraint on folioNo.

title: Early check-in time earlier than property check-in time is accepted without flag
whatHappensNow: No comparison with property.checkInTime during check-in creation.
fixNeeded: Warn (not block) if checkin time is before property.checkInTime. Log early check-in in AuditLog.

title: Invoice PDF does not show CGST/SGST breakdown — fails compliance
whatHappensNow: Invoice PDF groups all tax as a single 'GST' line.
fixNeeded: After WP-0.4 stores CGST/SGST/IGST per line, PDF renders them separately.

title: Purchase order total can be zero or negative — no validation
whatHappensNow: PO form accepts totalAmount <= 0.
fixNeeded: Zod: PO total must be > 0. Each line item qty > 0 and rate > 0.

title: HR dashboard KPIs (attendance rate, leave balance) not computed from real data
whatHappensNow: HR page shows placeholder percentages.
fixNeeded: Compute from Attendance, LeaveRequest, StaffMember tables. Show empty state when no data.

title: KOT number sequence is global — two properties can generate same KOT number
whatHappensNow: KotTicket.kotNo uses a global counter. Multi-property setups duplicate KOT numbers.
fixNeeded: Per-property KOT sequence: kotNo format = {propertyCode}-{YYYYMMDD}-{seq}.

title: Order modification after KOT is sent does not create a void/reprint KOT
whatHappensNow: Editing a KOT item after sending shows no cancel/void indication on the kitchen display.
fixNeeded: Modification creates a new VOID KOT for cancelled items and a NEW KOT for added items.

title: Table status does not update when order is settled — table remains OCCUPIED
whatHappensNow: After order payment, table status stays OCCUPIED. Waiter must manually reset.
fixNeeded: On order settlement (PAID status): set table.status = VACANT.

title: Counter payment shift totals include void/cancelled orders
whatHappensNow: DayClosing totals include orders with status=CANCELLED in cash totals.
fixNeeded: Filter: exclude CANCELLED and VOID orders from all counter payment aggregations.

title: Loyalty points tier thresholds not configurable — hardcoded in UI
whatHappensNow: Silver/Gold/Platinum tier thresholds are hardcoded in the loyalty page component.
fixNeeded: Move to MembershipPlan configuration table. Admin can set thresholds.

title: Report date range filter defaults to current browser date, not hotel business date
whatHappensNow: Date pickers default to new Date() (UTC wall clock) instead of IST business date.
fixNeeded: Default to getHotelBusinessDate() in IST.

title: Booking wizard default date is UTC midnight, shows wrong date at night in India
whatHappensNow: New booking form defaults arrivalDate to new Date() which after midnight UTC shows yesterday's IST date.
fixNeeded: Use businessDate() from lib/time.ts as default.

title: Agent can be created without KYC document upload — no validation
whatHappensNow: Agent creation succeeds even with empty document fields.
fixNeeded: requirePermission(session, 'agents.kyc.view'). Block receptionist from agent KYC management.

title: Bike rental portal has no link to hotel PMS — revenue not posted to folio
whatHappensNow: Bike rental is a standalone portal; charges cannot be posted to a hotel guest folio.
fixNeeded: Add 'Post to Room' option in bike rental checkout that calls /api/hotel/post-to-room.

title: Guest concierge requests (housekeeping, room service) not linked to active reservation
whatHappensNow: HousekeepingTask has no reservationId — cannot filter tasks by current guest's stay.
fixNeeded: Add reservationId to HousekeepingTask (optional). Link room service orders to active CheckIn.

title: Bar display shows UTC timestamp — wrong time visible to customers
whatHappensNow: Bar display clock renders toLocaleString() without timezone spec, shows UTC in some browsers.
fixNeeded: Use Intl.DateTimeFormat with Asia/Kolkata for all customer-facing displays.

title: Banquet advance payment cannot be posted to accounting
whatHappensNow: No BanquetBooking model — no way to record advance and post to ledger.
fixNeeded: After WP-0.9 adds BanquetBooking, wire advance payment to ledger via ledger.service.ts.

title: Multi-property user defaults to wrong hotel after login
whatHappensNow: A user with access to two properties always lands on the first property in DB, not their last-used or assigned property.
fixNeeded: Property switcher persists last selection in localStorage. Session defaults to it on next login.

title: Discount approval inbox in admin panel does not exist
whatHappensNow: No /hotel/discounts page or component shows pending approval requests.
fixNeeded: Build ApprovalRequest inbox at /hotel/discounts. Show PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED with timestamps.

title: Settings page GSTIN field has no format validation
whatHappensNow: Any string can be saved as property GSTIN, including invalid ones.

title: Booking with checkOut before checkIn is accepted
whatHappensNow: No server-side check that arrivalDate < departureDate.
fixNeeded: Zod: departureDate > arrivalDate. API returns 400.

title: Same-day arrival and departure (0-night stay) is accepted
whatHappensNow: arrivalDate == departureDate creates a 0-night booking with ₹0 room charge.
fixNeeded: Minimum 1 night. Zod: nights >= 1.

title: Booking guest phone number accepts 7-digit or international formats
whatHappensNow: Guest mobile saved on booking has no format validation.
fixNeeded: Zod: mobile.regex(/^[6-9]\d{9}$/).

title: Cancelled booking room is not released back to availability
whatHappensNow: Cancelling a booking updates status to CANCELLED but room remains blocked in the availability query.
fixNeeded: Availability query excludes CANCELLED and NO_SHOW statuses.

title: Folio PDF does not show property logo
whatHappensNow: hotel-print-utils.ts does not embed property.logoUrl in the PDF header.
fixNeeded: Fetch property.logoUrl (base64 or URL) and embed in PDF.

title: Folio transaction description truncated to 50 chars — loses detail
whatHappensNow: FolioTransaction.description has no length validation; some descriptions are truncated in UI.
fixNeeded: Allow up to 255 chars. Migrate schema if needed.

title: Invoice number does not reset per financial year
whatHappensNow: Invoice numbers are sequential without FY prefix. 1001 from FY 2025-26 looks the same as 1001 from FY 2026-27.
fixNeeded: InvoiceSeries(propertyId, fy, prefix, next). Format: GST-26-27-0001.

title: Invoice list page does not filter by date range
whatHappensNow: hotel/billing/invoices shows all invoices with no date filter.
fixNeeded: Add date-range filter. API supports startDate/endDate query params.

title: Indian rupee symbol ₹ renders as ? on some Android/Windows devices
whatHappensNow: Font does not include the ₹ glyph on some system fonts.
fixNeeded: Use CSS font-family with Noto Sans or include ₹ in the web font.

title: Mobile viewport broken on some hotel module pages
whatHappensNow: hotel/night-audit and hotel/accounts pages overflow horizontally on mobile.
fixNeeded: Add overflow-x-hidden and responsive table wrappers.

title: Day closing can be run twice for the same shift
whatHappensNow: No uniqueness check on DayClosing(shiftId). Two closings for same shift are accepted.
fixNeeded: @@unique([shiftId]) on DayClosing or status check before creation.

title: Expense attachment URL not validated — any string accepted as attachment
whatHappensNow: Expense.attachmentUrl stores any input string without URL validation.
fixNeeded: Zod: attachmentUrl.url() or only accept paths from /api/upload.

title: Maintenance ticket falls back to mock data when API returns empty array
whatHappensNow: hotel/maintenance/page.tsx creates a mock MaintenanceTicket when API returns [].
fixNeeded: Show empty state component instead of mock data.

title: Housekeeping task priority dropdown has no default — empty priority saves to DB
whatHappensNow: Priority field is not set in task creation form; NULL is saved.
fixNeeded: Default priority to 'NORMAL'. Zod enum: ['LOW', 'NORMAL', 'HIGH', 'URGENT'].

title: Super Admin panel accessible via direct URL without 2FA
whatHappensNow: /admin/* pages check role===SUPER_ADMIN in JWT but have no 2FA gate.
fixNeeded: Super admin actions require TOTP confirmation (Phase 1 WP-1.11).

title: Audit log does not capture IP address for all write operations
whatHappensNow: AuditLog rows are created for some actions but ip field is never populated.
fixNeeded: Extract client IP from request headers (x-forwarded-for) and store in AuditLog.ip.
